paper_title: Gated Attention for Large Language Models Non-linearity, Sparsity, and   Attention-Sink-Free
caption: Comparison of massive activations and attention sink phenomena across different gating configurations. Row 1 (Baseline): Significant massive activations and attention sinks emerge after the 6th layer. Row 2 (SDPA Gating): Reduced activations and no attention sinks observed. Row 3 (Value Layer Gating): Similar activations to Row 2 but with residual attention sinks. Rows 4–5 (Reduced Sparsity via cross-head share and NS-sigmoid): Massive activations and attention sinks resemble the baseline.

model_annotations.Bulgarian: Тази линейна диаграма илюстрира промяната на максималната стойност на активацията (Max Activation Value) в зависимост от номера на слоя (Layer) за четири различни компоненти в архитектурата на езиков модел: `attn_output`, `ffn_output`, `attn_residual` и `ffn_residual`. Оста X, означена като “Layer”, представлява номера на слоя и варира от 0 до 24, с етикети на интервали от 5 (0, 5, 10, 15, 20). Оста Y, означена като “Max Activation Value”, е линейна и варира от 0 до 400, с етикети на интервали от 50 (0, 50, 100, ..., 400). Четирите линии са представени с различни цветове и стилове: `attn_output` (синя пунктирана линия с кръгли маркери), `ffn_output` (зелена пунктирана линия с кръгли маркери), `attn_residual` (оранжева точкована линия с кръгли маркери) и `ffn_residual` (червена плътна линия). Всички линии започват близо до нула при слой 0. До слой 15, всички стойности остават под 50, с лек растеж. След слой 15, `ffn_residual` (червена линия) започва да расте по-бързо, достигайки стойност около 150 при слой 20 и над 350 при слой 24. `attn_residual` (оранжева точкована) следва сходна тенденция, но с по-ниски стойности — около 250 при слой 24. `attn_output` (синя пунктирана) и `ffn_output` (зелена пунктирана) остават под 50 до слой 20, след което изведнъж се увеличават — `attn_output` достига около 100, а `ffn_output` около 150 при слой 24. Няма видими участъци без промяна или спадове — всички линии показват монотонно или почти монотонно нарастване, особено в последните слоеве.
model_annotations.Chinese: 该图表展示了在不同门控配置下，Transformer模型各层中“atten_output_gate”相关组件的最大激活值随层数变化的趋势，旨在比较大规模激活与注意力沉没现象的出现情况；横轴为“Layer”，表示模型的层数，范围从0到约23，采用线性刻度，主要刻度间隔为5；纵轴为“Max Activation Value”，表示各层中对应组件的最大激活值，范围从0到400，采用线性刻度，主要刻度间隔为50；图中包含四条曲线：蓝色虚线“attn_output”在前15层基本维持在0至10之间，第17层左右短暂上升至约30后回落，第21层后急剧上升至约110；绿色虚线“ffn_output”在前18层基本维持在0至10之间，第20层后开始上升，第22层达到约160；橙色点线“attn_residual”在前6层接近0，第8层后缓慢上升，第18层后加速增长，第22层达到约260；红色实线“ffn_residual”在前6层接近0，之后持续缓慢上升，第18层后加速增长，第22层达到约390。
model_annotations.English: The line plot titled “Massive Activation of atten_output_gate” illustrates the maximum activation values across model layers for four distinct components: `attn_output` (blue dashed line), `ffn_output` (green dashed line), `attn_residual` (orange dotted line), and `ffn_residual` (red solid line). The x-axis, labeled “Layer,” spans from 0 to approximately 24 with linear spacing and integer tick labels at intervals of 5. The y-axis, labeled “Max Activation Value,” ranges from 0 to 400 with linear scaling and tick marks at intervals of 50. All four lines begin near zero at Layer 0 and remain relatively flat through Layer 10. Starting around Layer 15, the red `ffn_residual` line begins a steep upward trend, reaching approximately 390 by Layer 23. The orange `attn_residual` line follows a similar but slightly delayed trajectory, peaking near 260 at Layer 23. In contrast, the blue `attn_output` and green `ffn_output` lines remain low until Layer 20, after which they both rise sharply — the blue line reaching about 110 and the green line reaching about 160 at Layer 23. The plot visually emphasizes the explosive growth in activation values for residual components in later layers, particularly for `ffn_residual`, while output components show delayed but still substantial growth.
model_annotations.German: The line chart titled “Massive Activation of atten_output_gate” plots the maximum activation value on the y-axis against the layer number on the x-axis, ranging from 0 to approximately 23. The y-axis is linearly scaled from 0 to 400, with tick marks at intervals of 50. Four distinct lines represent different components: “attn_output” (blue dashed line with circular markers), “ffn_output” (green dash-dotted line with circular markers), “attn_residual” (orange dotted line with circular markers), and “ffn_residual” (solid red line). All lines begin near zero at layer 0. The “ffn_residual” line (red) rises gradually until layer 15, then steeply increases to nearly 400 by layer 23. The “attn_residual” line (orange) follows a similar but slightly delayed trajectory, peaking around 260 at layer 23. The “attn_output” line (blue) remains near zero until layer 18, then sharply rises to approximately 110 by layer 23. The “ffn_output” line (green) stays near zero until layer 20, then climbs to about 170 by layer 23. All lines exhibit nonlinear growth, with the most dramatic increases occurring after layer 18.
